key_insights.insight: Legacy System Risk is Critical Attack Vector
key_insights.description: Checkout.com breach via improperly decommissioned 2020-era third-party cloud storage demonstrates forgotten systems become security liabilities. Active decommissioning required, not passive neglect.
evidence: Checkout.com: <25% merchants affected by legacy system breach
Root cause: Third-party cloud storage not decommissioned properly
Attack vector: Old credentials and access remained valid
Hacker News score: 425 (high community engagement)
action_items: Inventory all GCP resources (Cloud Run, Storage, service accounts)
Identify unused/legacy resources from experimentation phase
Establish quarterly decommissioning review process
Document: 'If not used in 90 days, decommission'

key_insights.insight: Ethical Ransomware Response Sets New Standard
key_insights.description: Checkout.com refused ransom payment, donated equivalent amount to cybersecurity research labs. Transparency and ethical response praised by community as new industry standard.
evidence: Checkout.com: No payment to ShinyHunters threat group
Donation to cybersecurity research labs instead
Transparent public disclosure within days
Full responsibility acknowledgment publicly
Overwhelmingly positive community response (425 HN points)
action_items: Create incident response plan with no-ransom-payment policy
Document ethical guidelines for security incidents
Establish transparency commitment: public disclosure within 24-48 hours
Identify security research organizations for potential donations

evidence: Android developer verification: mandatory for app publishing

Community appreciation for early announcement and feedback period
Platform scale demands governance: Android's global reach
